_what: C-9: the sorceress's v2 scene package (so_d7/scene_pkg, commit b78f48c5e) on the painted Barrow -- her feet against the asked speed before (v1) and after (v2), and her spells' releases -- godot/tools/capture_painted.gd --feet [--feet-passes 4] --cast --c sorceress
_instrument: driven straight across the arena by drive_dir at walk and at run (her own tick off); every physics frame the body and the four foot joints in world space; the stance foot = the lower toe, within 3 cm of its lowest; asked = the body's ground speed, foot_lock = the stance foot's speed relative to the body, ratio = foot_lock / asked (1.0 = the feet grip), skate = the stance foot's own ground speed
_passes: single = T12_10's measure exactly (one pass east from u -5). pooled_4 = four passes alternating east and west across the same strip, frames pooled: v2's run is 16% faster than v1's, so a single pass crosses the arena in about 1.4 s of measured frames (34 stance frames) and its median moves with the sampling; the pooled figure has 139

reading.walk: ratio 1.019 -> 0.994 (asked 1.471 -> 1.508 m/s; the foot-lock speed is the same 1.499): the package's predicted 0.994, exactly
reading.run: ratio 1.148 -> 0.971 single / 0.996 pooled (asked 3.985 -> 4.602 m/s): the 15% over-stride is gone; the package predicted 0.993
reading.run_skate: her planted foot still moves 0.67 m/s median in the run's stance frames (p90 1.84); his, by the same rule, 0.29. With her ratio at 1.0 this is not a speed mismatch: the median of the stance foot's speed relative to the body matches the asked speed, its spread does not -- most likely the clip's own contact (the foot not holding still against her hips through the stance, or the stance rule's 3 cm band taking in her landing and lift-off). Not investigated further here. Walk skate 0.089 median (v1 0.106).
